import json
rows=json.load(open('teams.json'))
avg={k:sum(r[k] for r in rows)/30 for k in ['sh3','sh2','shft']}
out=[]
keys=['pts','drtg','efg','twop','tpp','tpm','tpar','ftr','tov','orb','astr','blk','stl','pts3','pts2','ptsft']
for r in rows:
    o={'team':r['team'],'name':r['name'],'gp':r['gp'],'poss':r['poss']}
    for k in keys: o[k]=r[k]; o[k+'_rk']=r[k+'_rk']
    o.update(sh3=r['sh3'],sh2=r['sh2'],shft=r['shft'],fta=r['fta'],to=r['to'],ast=r['ast'])
    o['weak']='; '.join(f"{l} (#{k})" for l,k in r['weak']) or 'No bottom-10 category'
    o['strong']='; '.join(f"{l} (#{k})" for l,k in r['strong']) or 'No top-10 category'
    o['biggest_hole']=r['weak'][0][0] if r['weak'] else 'None in the bottom 10'
    # most-scored-on source = highest points-allowed rank (worst) among 3PT/2PT/FT
    src={'3-pointers':r['pts3_rk'],'2-pointers (inside the arc)':r['pts2_rk'],'free throws':r['ptsft_rk']}
    o['scored_on_most']=max(src,key=src.get)
    out.append(o)
meta=[{"label":"export.py","value":open('export.py').read(),"type":"code","lang":"python"},
      {"label":"calc.py","value":open('calc.py').read(),"type":"code","lang":"python"},

json.dump({'rows':out,'meta':meta},open('nba_defense_2026_27.json','w'))
print(len(out), out[0]['weak'])

import csv,json
names={'LAL':'Los Angeles Lakers','MEM':'Memphis Grizzlies','MIA':'Miami Heat','SAS':'San Antonio Spurs','CLE':'Cleveland Cavaliers','POR':'Portland Trail Blazers','HOU':'Houston Rockets','ATL':'Atlanta Hawks','MIN':'Minnesota Timberwolves','NOP':'New Orleans Pelicans','DET':'Detroit Pistons','GSW':'Golden State Warriors','BOS':'Boston Celtics','CHI':'Chicago Bulls','PHI':'Philadelphia 76ers','DEN':'Denver Nuggets','TOR':'Toronto Raptors','PHX':'Phoenix Suns','LAC':'LA Clippers','OKC':'Oklahoma City Thunder','DAL':'Dallas Mavericks','IND':'Indiana Pacers','WAS':'Washington Wizards','BKN':'Brooklyn Nets','NYK':'New York Knicks','ORL':'Orlando Magic','SAC':'Sacramento Kings','UTA':'Utah Jazz','MIL':'Milwaukee Bucks','CHA':'Charlotte Hornets'}
rows=[]
for r in csv.DictReader(open('raw.csv')):
    d={k:(float(v) if k!='team' else v) for k,v in r.items()}
    poss=d['FGA']+0.44*d['FTA']-d['OR']+d['TO']
    twm=d['FGM']-d['TPM']; twa=d['FGA']-d['TPA']
    o=dict(team=d['team'],name=names[d['team']],gp=int(d['GP']),pts=d['PTS'],poss=round(poss,1),
      drtg=round(d['PTS']/poss*100,1),
      efg=round((d['FGM']+0.5*d['TPM'])/d['FGA']*100,1),
      fgp=d['FGp'],twop=round(twm/twa*100,1),tpp=d['TPp'],
      tpa=d['TPA'],tpm=d['TPM'],tpar=round(d['TPA']/d['FGA']*100,1),
      ftr=round(d['FTA']/d['FGA']*100,1),fta=d['FTA'],
      tov=round(d['TO']/poss*100,1),to=d['TO'],
      orb=d['OR'],ast=d['AST'],astr=round(d['AST']/d['FGM']*100,1),stl=d['STL'],blk=d['BLK'],pf=d['PF'],
      pts3=round(d['TPM']*3,1),pts2=round(twm*2,1),ptsft=d['FTM'])
    o['sh3']=round(o['pts3']/d['PTS']*100,1);o['sh2']=round(o['pts2']/d['PTS']*100,1);o['shft']=round(o['ptsft']/d['PTS']*100,1)
    rows.append(o)
# rank: 1 = best defense
lowbest=['pts','drtg','efg','fgp','twop','tpp','tpm','tpar','ftr','orb','ast','astr','pts3','pts2','ptsft','pf']
highbest=['tov','to','stl','blk']
for k in lowbest+highbest:
    s=sorted(rows,key=lambda x:x[k],reverse=k in highbest)
    for r in rows:
        r[k+'_rk']=1+sum(1 for x in rows if (x[k]<r[k] if k in lowbest else x[k]>r[k]))
labels={'drtg':'Overall efficiency','efg':'Shot quality allowed (eFG%)','twop':'Inside-the-arc / 2PT defense','tpp':'3PT % allowed','tpm':'3s made allowed','tpar':'Letting teams hunt 3s (3PA rate)','ftr':'Fouling / FT trips allowed','tov':'Forcing turnovers','orb':'Defensive rebounding (opp OREB)','astr':'Ball-movement defense (opp AST%)','blk':'Rim protection (blocks)','stl':'Steals/disruption','pts2':'2PT points allowed','ptsft':'FT points allowed'}
for r in rows:
    w=[(labels[k],r[k+'_rk']) for k in labels if r[k+'_rk']>=21]
    s=[(labels[k],r[k+'_rk']) for k in labels if r[k+'_rk']<=10]
    r['weak']=sorted(w,key=lambda x:-x[1]); r['strong']=sorted(s,key=lambda x:x[1])
    src={'3PT':r['sh3'],'2PT':r['sh2'],'FT':r['shft']}
    r['src_rank']={'3PT':r['pts3_rk'],'2PT':r['pts2_rk'],'FT':r['ptsft_rk']}
rows.sort(key=lambda x:x['drtg'])
for i,r in enumerate(rows): r['drtg_rk']=i+1
json.dump(rows,open('teams.json','w'),indent=1)
avg={k:round(sum(r[k] for r in rows)/30,1) for k in ['pts','drtg','efg','twop','tpp','tpar','ftr','tov','orb','sh3','sh2','shft']}
print(avg)
for r in rows: print(r['drtg_rk'],r['team'],r['drtg'],r['efg'],r['twop'],r['tpp'],r['ftr'],r['tov'],r['orb'],'| W:',[w[0][:14]+str(w[1]) for w in r['weak'][:4]])
